First, find the score of the second student:  
3 wrong out of 40 means 40 - 3 = 37 correct.  
As a percentage: (37/40) × 100 = 92.5%.  

The first student scored 95%, which is higher than 92.5%.  
To have the highest score, Sierra must beat 95%.  
The maximum possible is 100%, which means getting all 40 questions right.  

So she needs to get 40 correct.  

Final answer: Sierra
